about.heading: About PracticeFlow
about.body: PracticeFlow is a personal project developed by Pedro Carramolino González to help you organize your music practice sessions. It is not a service provided by a registered company.

usage.heading: Using the service
usage.item1: You need an account to use PracticeFlow. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for any activity that happens on your account.
usage.item2: You must provide real information when registering (a valid email) and must not use the app for illegal purposes, or to harass or harm other people through the Community feature.
usage.item3: We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms.

availability.heading: Service availability
availability.body: PracticeFlow is provided “as is”, without guarantees of continuous availability. Being a personal project, the service may experience interruptions, changes, or ultimately be discontinued; we'll try to give reasonable notice if that were to happen while your data is at stake.

content.heading: Content you upload
content.body: The content you write (session notes, category names, etc.) is yours. By using Community, you agree that your username and your aggregate progress (not your session details) will be visible to the people you accept as friends.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, PracticeFlow is provided without warranties of any kind, and we are not liable for data loss or damages arising from use of the service, beyond what applicable regulations require.

law.heading: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For any questions about these terms, write to <email>pedrocarramolino34@gmail.com</email>.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.body: Pedro Carramolino González, as an individual, is the controller responsible for the data PracticeFlow collects. You can reach out with any questions about your data at <email>pedrocarramolino34@gmail.com</email>.

dataCollected.heading: What data we collect
dataCollected.item1: Account data: email address, username, and password (the latter is never stored in plain text; it's managed by our authentication provider).
dataCollected.item2: Practice data: the sessions you log (blocks, categories, duration, any notes you write), and the templates and custom categories you create.
dataCollected.item3: Community data: your invite code, your accepted or pending friendships, and the aggregate weekly minutes and streak your friends can see.
dataCollected.item4: Reminders: the time and days you configure, and your timezone.
dataCollected.item5: Push notifications: if you enable them, your browser gives us a subscription identifier and encryption keys needed to send you alerts — we don't use them for anything else.
dataCollected.item6: Basic technical data generated by any web service (IP address, browser type) through our hosting provider, for security and to keep the service running.
dataCollected.outro: We don't collect payment data (PracticeFlow has no purchases or subscriptions) and we don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

dataUse.heading: What we use your data for
dataUse.item1: So you can sign in and use the app.
dataUse.item2: To save and show you your practice history and statistics.
dataUse.item3: For the Community feature: showing your aggregate progress (not your session details) to the people you accept as friends, and vice versa.
dataUse.item4: To send you the push notifications and reminders you enable yourself.
dataUse.item5: To keep the service running securely.
dataUse.outro: We don't sell or transfer your data to third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.

dataSharing.heading: Who we share your data with
dataSharing.intro: We use the following providers to run PracticeFlow, who process data on our behalf:
dataSharing.item3Rest: — scheduled delivery of push notifications at the exact configured time.
dataSharing.item4: The browser you use (Chrome, Firefox, Safari…) handles the technical delivery of push notifications through its own push service, as a standard part of that web technology.
dataSharing.outro: None of these providers may use your data for their own purposes.

retention.heading: How long we keep your data
retention.body: For as long as you keep your account active. If you want to delete your account and all your data, write to us at <email>pedrocarramolino34@gmail.com</email> and we'll do so within a reasonable timeframe — there's currently no self-service option inside the app.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: If you live in the European Union, you have the right to access your data, correct it, request its deletion, restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. You can exercise these rights by writing to <email>pedrocarramolino34@gmail.com</email>. You can also file a complaint with the <aepd>Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD)</aepd>.

minors.heading: Minors
minors.body: PracticeFlow is not directed at children under 14. If you are under that age, you need your legal guardian's consent to use the app.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we make relevant changes to this policy, we'll note it on this same page along with the date of the last update.
